<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="utterplan-format-v7">
<h1>UtterPlan format v7</h1>
<p>Current plans are persisted as UTF-8 TOML in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.utterplan.toml</span></code> files with root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">format</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;utterplan&quot;</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema_version</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">7</span></code>. Schema v5 introduced ordered flow units; v6 added optional exact-source provenance; v7 removes renderer-selected root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unit</span></code> and adds canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_before</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_after</span></code> opportunities distinct from authored pause intents. The canonical Python model is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>.</p>
<p>A minimal plan looks like this:</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">format</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;utterplan&quot;</span>
<span class="n">schema_version</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">7</span>
<span class="n">plan_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;sha256:...&quot;</span>
<span class="n">language</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span>
<span class="n">hash_schema</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;utterplan-flow-v3&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[document]</span>
<span class="n">format</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;plain&quot;</span>
<span class="n">semantics</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{}</span>

<span class="k">[source]</span>
<span class="n">format</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;plain&quot;</span>
<span class="n">text</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello world.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">sha256</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;sha256:&lt;digest-of-exact-UTF-8-source&gt;&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[[flow]]</span>
<span class="n">hash</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;sha256:...&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[[flow.segment]]</span>
<span class="n">text</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello world.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">token</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">span</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">12</span><span class="p">]]</span>
<span class="n">boundary_after</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&quot;sentence&quot;</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">pause_after</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;none&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<section id="compiler-only-segmentation-topology">
<h2>Compiler-only segmentation topology</h2>
<p>The compiler validates PhraseSplit proposals and owns paragraph, sentence, and sentence-part spans in spoken-text coordinates. Semicolon/context-safe colon boundaries, optional clause/parenthetical proposals, and deterministic comma fallback may contribute safe boundary opportunities. A fallback comma is a soft <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clause</span></code> opportunity only when lexical content occurs on both sides; token-edge reconciliation still applies, and candidates inside atomic replacement/media spans (or immediately after a substitution target) are suppressed. These opportunities do not activate pauses. Language, directive, authored-pause, marker, and media cuts create canonical segments without applying downstream chunk or pause policy. If proposals are malformed or incomplete, deterministic fallback is used and prepared speech text remains intact.</p>
<p>Sentence parts and their indices remain compiler-private in v7. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">flow</span></code> uses fixed paragraph-local <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowUnit</span></code> grouping, and its <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment</span></code> records expose canonical safe-boundary opportunities; renderer chunk topology is not serialized. Released v5/v6 formats and their historical hashes remain unchanged.</p>
</section>
<section id="executable-flow">
<h2>Executable flow</h2>
<p>Each ordered <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">flow</span></code> entry is a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowUnit</span></code> with a stable local <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hash</span></code> and one or more <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment</span></code> entries. A segment contains already-prepared speech <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>, an optional language override, local token columns, optional compact replacement provenance, optional semantic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_before</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_after</span></code> intents, typed renderer-neutral directives, markers, and an optional heading level. Language defaults to the root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">language</span></code>; units always group the canonical paragraph-local flow and the schema has no renderer-selected root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unit</span></code>. Consumers render segments in the stored order and do not need compiler lookup tables or segment-ID joins.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_before</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_after</span></code> list unique safe opportunities from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clause</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sentence</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">paragraph</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parenthetical</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice_change</span></code> in canonical order; a parenthetical or sentence opportunity is not a pause directive. Authored pause intents are kept separately, so a boundary and an authored <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code>, strength, or timed break can coexist at one edge. A <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment</span></code> is a semantic plan segment, not necessarily a renderer call or final TTS chunk.</p>
<p>Consumers may project saved flow into <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clause</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sentence</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">paragraph</span></code> preview chunks without changing schema-v7 data. The public preview concatenates each selected chunk’s stored <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text</span></code> exactly; token and replacement spans remain local to their original segments. Pause policies are projections only and do not persist renderer timing or activate boundaries in the plan.</p>
<p>Token <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">span</span></code> entries are half-open Python-character ranges local to their owning segment’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pos</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tag</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lemma</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">morph</span></code> carry final prepared-text linguistic facts; dense columns align with spans and sparse columns use ascending <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[token_index,</span> <span class="pre">value]</span></code> pairs. Absent lemma values derive from case-folded surface text; an explicit empty sparse lemma preserves an unknown value. These fields describe linguistic tokens, not engine token IDs or model-token counts; consumers may pass the context through without retokenizing or rerunning spaCy.</p>
<p>Optional compact <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">replacement</span></code> columns explain text preparation without restoring the compiler graph. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">replacement.span</span></code> is a list of half-open spans in the final prepared segment <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">replacement.source</span></code> holds the original spelling for each span. For example, in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&quot;Because</span> <span class="pre">someone</span> <span class="pre">(A</span> <span class="pre">R</span> <span class="pre">T)</span> <span class="pre">thought...&quot;</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">replacement.span</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">[[17,</span> <span class="pre">22]]</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">replacement.source</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">[&quot;ART&quot;]</span></code>, because <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text[17:22]</span> <span class="pre">==</span> <span class="pre">&quot;A</span> <span class="pre">R</span> <span class="pre">T&quot;</span></code>. Optional <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">kind</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rule</span></code> columns are sparse <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[replacement_index,</span> <span class="pre">value]</span></code> pairs. Replacement provenance is not a synthesis input and is excluded from flow-unit hashes and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_id</span></code>; schema v7 includes the exact source digest when a source record is available. Full source offsets and preparation maps remain in the trace sidecar.
The prepared output string is not duplicated; recover it as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment.text[start:end]</span></code>.</p>
<p>Pause intents represent authored <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code>, strength values (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">x-weak</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">weak</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">medium</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">strong</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">x-strong</span></code>), or an exact authored timed break. Safe sentence and parenthetical opportunities are boundary kinds, not pause intents. UtterPlan does not activate automatic pauses or assign durations; consumers choose native, automatic, or manual realization, and exact authored times remain explicit. Directives are typed renderer-neutral semantics for voice, pronunciation, prosody, emphasis, say-as, substitution, audio references, and extension references. UtterPlan does not fetch audio or execute extensions.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">document</span></code> holds compact <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">DocumentInfo</span></code> such as source format, SSMD version, title, and portable document semantics. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">linguistics</span></code> optionally lists provider/model provenance. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">producer</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">warnings</span></code> are informational; newly compiled v7 plans include <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">producer.text_preparation</span></code> with the resolved <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ssmd</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spokenform</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">identity</span></code> mode (older migrated plans may not have it). This field is provenance, not a replayable configuration object, and does not affect plan identity. The optional v6 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source</span></code> record retains exact raw input once; it may be absent on migrated v5 plans. The executable plan does not retain compiler text-preparation objects, parser/provider documents, arbitrary global token tables, or diagnostic lookup graphs.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_id</span></code> identifies canonical executable semantics and, in schema v7, the SHA-256 digest of exact raw source when available; it does not hash TOML bytes. The plan-level <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hash_schema</span></code> is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan-flow-v3</span></code>; canonical boundary opportunities and authored pause intents participate in executable identity and flow-unit hashes. Compact replacement provenance is excluded. Producer identity and formatting do not alter executable identity. Plans contain no phonemes, model token IDs, models, sessions, renderer configuration, or audio.</p>
</section>
<section id="toml-api-and-optional-compiler-trace">
<h2>TOML API and optional compiler trace</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.to_toml()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.from_toml()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.save()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.load()</span></code> are the persistence APIs. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">save()</span></code> writes atomically. Normal plan loading and the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">inspect</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">explain</span></code> commands accept TOML; JSON is never auto-detected as a current plan format. Import a historical plan explicitly with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span></code>; schema-v6 data cannot be promoted to v7 without recompiling the original source, so migration may report <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">migration.recompile_required</span></code> instead of writing a file.</p>
<p>Full compiler provenance is optional and separate from executable flow. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">compile</span> <span class="pre">--trace</span> <span class="pre">plan.trace.toml</span></code> writes a versioned trace sidecar containing source text/hash, structural and prepared text, coordinate maps, preparation changes, compiler-only plan state, diagnostics, and renderability evidence. Schema v6 also stores exact raw input in the plan’s optional source record. Compact segment-local replacement views in v7 flow are not a substitute for full source maps. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">explain</span> <span class="pre">plan.utterplan.toml</span> <span class="pre">--trace</span> <span class="pre">plan.trace.toml</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">inspect-trace</span> <span class="pre">plan.trace.toml</span></code>. Trace data does not enter <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>, plan identity, or plan TOML; compiling with and without a trace produces identical executable plans.</p>
<p>The v7 TOML codec is a deterministic human-oriented projection of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>, not a dump of arbitrary Python object state. Direct TOML nulls, dates/times, non-finite floats, and unknown fields are rejected. Optional typed fields are omitted; free-form <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">document.semantics</span></code> preserves embedded nulls with the reserved <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__utterplan_null__</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">true</span></code> table. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__utterplan_</span></code> prefix is reserved. Use the public codec rather than manually reconstructing model objects.</p>
</section>
<section id="historical-json-schemas-and-migration">
<h2>Historical JSON schemas and migration</h2>
<p>Frozen JSON Schema resources for v1, v2, v3, and v4 remain under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spec/schemas/</span></code> and their versioned package copies. They describe historical serialized semantic mappings, not current TOML syntax. Schemas v5, v6, and v7 deliberately have no JSON Schema resources or JSON plan-file format: validity is defined by their versioned <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code> models and TOML codecs. Historical files and fixtures remain versioned and immutable.</p>
<p>Historical plans retain sequential data-only migration steps from v1 through v6, available only through the explicit migration API/CLI. Normal decoding and execution do not invoke this chain: they reject non-v7 plans with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema.version_unsupported</span></code>. The registered v6-to-v7 step refuses with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">migration.recompile_required</span></code>, because v6 may omit renderer-dependent automatic boundaries. Earlier steps operate on serialized plain data only and never parse SSMD, invoke preparation or NLP, plan, call G2P, render, or process audio. The v4-to-v5 step verifies token ownership/coordinates and authored pause meaning rather than guessing; v5-to-v6 preserves compiled semantics without inventing source provenance. Recompile the original source to obtain a complete v7 boundary inventory.</p>
<p>Package version and plan schema version are independent. Historical schema files are never rewritten to match the package. Downgrades from v7 are not supported.</p>
</section>
<section id="coordinate-and-provenance-rules">
<h2>Coordinate and provenance rules</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Token <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">span</span></code> offsets address Python characters in the owning <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment.text</span></code> only.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment.text</span></code> is the prepared speech text for that segment.</p></li>
<li><p>Compiler trace source spans address exact input-source Python-character offsets; trace structural/spoken maps and preparation changes document their coordinate spaces explicitly.</p></li>
<li><p>The executable plan does not contain complete source offsets or dense text maps. Compact replacement views retain only segment-local output spans and original spelling strings; preserve a trace sidecar for source diagnostics, full preparation maps, or provenance that must survive a process boundary.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The codec validates token ordering and bounds, directive shape, flow hashes, plan identity, and supported schema version before returning a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>. Historical model decoding remains separate from the current v7 model.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
